beats.text: Four minutes to liquidation. You're not looking at your phone.
WickSight puts the position on your glasses. Size, PnL, distance to the line — and time.
Say: alert sixty-one thousand five hundred. It arms while the app is open, and fires when the mark hits.
Then the decision. Close half. WickSight previews the exact order, sized to the position. Default is No. Swipe to Yes, then tap. Reduce-only, on Binance testnet. Nothing else changes.
The receipt shows what changed. Liquidation moves away, and the buffer nearly doubles.
Testnet only. Keys server-side. Every order needs an explicit yes. WickSight. See the liquidation coming — and get out of it.
